question: Which petal letters must be gathered into the lotus womb during this stage?
premises: The letters range from va to sa.
These letters are situated on the petals.
They are to be gathered in the lotus womb.
inference: The practitioner should gather the petal letters from va to sa into the lotus womb.
plain_english: One should gather the letters situated on the petals, from va to sa, into the womb of the lotus.
